correctness.rationale: A=-Q+D is positive self-adjoint in L²(pi) under detailed balance and positive mean event rate: <f,Af>=1/2 sum pi_i q_ij(f_i-f_j)^2+sum pi_i lambda_i f_i². Spectral weights at 1 are nonnegative and sum to one, giving hyperexponential S_pi(t). Its hazard derivative is minus a positive tilted variance, and h_pi(0)=lambda_*. Palm initialization gives S_alpha(t)=-S_pi_prime(t)/lambda_*=(h_pi(t)/lambda_*) S_pi(t), hence S_pi>=S_alpha, strict for all t>0 unless all lambda_i equal. Handles rates lambda_i=0 and nonuniform pi; independent reconstruction, not finite extrapolation.
